title: YOLO Cottage
meta_description: YOLO Cottage is a luxury 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath Rosemary Beach vacation rental sleeping up to 10 guests. Enjoy a private pool, hot tub, outdoor fireplace, and bikes in the heart of Rosemary Beach—perfect for an unforgettable 30A getaway.
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Private & Convenient Beach Access - Gulf Views - Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1-May 1) - 5 Adult Bikes Welcome to YOLO Cottage, a stunning coastal retreat located on the south side of 30A in Rosemary Beach, offering breathtaking ocean views and an unbeatable location just steps from the Gulf. A private gate from the home’s pool courtyard opens directly onto Rosemary Beach’s private Beach Access A boardwalk, providing stroller- and wheelchair-friendly access and a very short walk to the sugar-white sand and emerald waters. Guests of YOLO Cottage enjoy access to Rosemary Beach’s renowned community amenities, including private beach access (with the option to host beach bonfires through RB), a full-service fitness center with daily classes such as yoga and massage services, three outdoor community pools, a heated indoor pool, and the beloved Rosemary Beach Racquet Club featuring eight lighted Har-Tru clay courts. The home is also within easy walking or biking distance of Rosemary Beach’s boutique shops, restaurants, and coastal entertainment. YOLO Cottage features four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms, thoughtfully designed for comfort, convenience, and relaxation. Upon entering the home, you’re welcomed by a stylish foyer with custom artwork and storage for beach-day essentials. An elevator services all three levels, making it easy to transport luggage, groceries, and vacation gear. The first floor offers a serene king guest suite with a luxury mattress, en-suite bathroom, and peaceful views of the pool, spa, and ocean beyond—perfect for guests who prefer easy access to the outdoor living space. A spacious bunk room features two Twin XL over Twin XL bunk beds, a Smart TV, and a private en-suite bath, making it ideal for children or teens. A full laundry room is also located on this level with direct access to the private courtyard. Step outside to the heart of YOLO Cottage’s outdoor living area, where a resort-style private pool and spa, grilling station, and alfresco dining for fourteen await. From the courtyard, guests enjoy rare, direct access to Rosemary Beach’s private boardwalk—just a few steps from the beach. The second floor includes a cozy sitting area with a balcony overlooking the community park, ideal for morning coffee or quiet downtime. The spacious primary suite features a luxury king bed, spa-inspired bathroom with double vanity, soaking tub overlooking the ocean, and an oversized marble shower. The suite’s expansive wraparound balcony offers some of the home’s most impressive ocean, pool, and spa views. An additional king guest suite on this level includes its own en-suite bath and private balcony overlooking the pool. The third floor is the showpiece of YOLO Cottage, offering an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen space with panoramic ocean views framed by Rosemary Beach’s iconic rooftops. The fully equipped kitchen, inviting living area, and large dining table create a perfect space for gathering. Step onto the massive wraparound balcony to enjoy abundant seating and a charming bed swing—ideal for afternoon naps, sunset cocktails, or listening to the waves roll in. YOLO Cottage offers the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and proximity to the beach, making it ideal for families or groups seeking a high-end Rosemary Beach experience. Sleeping Arrangement First Floor - King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only - Bunkroom, 2 XL Twin over Twin, Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only Second Floor - Master King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Separate - King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combo
